skills.name: Strategist Longform
skills.activity: Core script-image-audio matching workflow & 16:9 widescreen longform video creation
skills.description: Sequences images to voiceover audio using Whisper STT & anchor phrases for 16:9 longform videos with motion varieties & max 8-word subtitles.

workflow.title: Check Inputs & AI Agent Thinking Initialization
workflow.instruction: Confirm script (text), images (anchor phrase filenames), and audio (voiceover) are all present. AI Agent enters step-by-step thinking & validation mode.

workflow.title: Connect to OpenAI Whisper STT for Word-Level Transcription
workflow.instruction: Run voiceover audio through OpenAI Whisper STT (Large-v3 engine) to extract word-level speech timestamps (exact start/end time of every spoken word).

workflow.title: Match Images to Script Anchors
workflow.instruction: Extract anchor phrases from image filenames (~first 5 words of sentence). Search script text sequentially for exact/near-exact matches.

workflow.title: Sequence Images
workflow.instruction: Order image clips according to the exact sequence their matched anchor phrases appear in the script text from start to finish.

workflow.title: Assign Timing to Each Image
workflow.instruction: Set image start time to Whisper audio timestamp where anchor phrase begins. Set end time to timestamp where next anchor phrase starts.

workflow.title: Confirm Full Timed Sequence
workflow.instruction: Verify every image has a precise start time, end time, and continuous timeline position derived from script text and Whisper speech audio.

workflow.title: Apply 16:9 Longform Motion Varieties, Crossfades & Max 8-Word Subtitles
workflow.instruction: Apply 16:9 framing, cycle 10 motion varieties (Zoom In, Zoom Out, Move L/R/U/D, Zoom & Move), 0.5s crossfades, and cap subtitles at 8 words max per card (or fewer based on audio beats).
workflow.decisionRule: Maintain clean, cinematic 16:9 documentary pacing with max 8 words per caption card.

skills.editingRules:
# Silent Strategist Skill — Core Matching Workflow

This describes the foundation stage of the Silent Strategist Skill: turning a script, a set of images, and a voiceover audio file into a fully sequenced and timed video with OpenAI Whisper STT, AI thinking reasoning, motion varieties, and tailored subtitle formatting.

## Step 1: Check Inputs & AI Agent Thinking Process
Confirm that all three required inputs are received: script text, image files, and voiceover audio track. The AI Agent enters a structured thinking state (reasoning through input validation, acoustic waveform analysis, and sequence alignment before execution).

## Step 2: OpenAI Whisper STT Word-Level Transcription
Run the voiceover audio through OpenAI Whisper STT (Large-v3 / API) configured for forced alignment to return word-level timestamps (exact start and end time of every individual spoken word).

## Step 3: Match Images to Script Anchor Phrases
Each image's filename is a short anchor phrase (typically the first ~5 words of a sentence in the script). Search the script text to locate each image's anchor phrase sequentially. The remaining words in a sentence belong to that same image until the next anchor phrase begins.

## Step 4: Sequence the Images
Order images in the exact order their anchor phrases appear in the script from start to finish.

## Step 5: Assign Timing to Each Image using Whisper
Set each image's start time to the Whisper timestamp where its anchor phrase begins being spoken. Set end time to where the next anchor phrase starts.

## Step 6: Confirm Full Timed Sequence
Ensure zero gaps and continuous timeline coverage from start to finish.

## Step 7: Apply Rich Motion Varieties
Cycle clips through diverse motion varieties:
1. **Zoom In**: Scale 1.00 → 1.18
2. **Zoom Out**: Scale 1.20 → 1.00
3. **Move Left**: Pan X +35 → -35
4. **Move Right**: Pan X -35 → +35
5. **Move Up**: Tilt Y +35 → -35
6. **Move Down**: Tilt Y -35 → +35
7. **Zoom & Move Left**: Scale 1.00 → 1.22 + Pan X 0 → -40
8. **Zoom & Move Right**: Scale 1.00 → 1.22 + Pan X 0 → +40
9. **Zoom & Move Up**: Scale 1.00 → 1.22 + Tilt Y 0 → -40
10. **Zoom & Move Down**: Scale 1.00 → 1.22 + Tilt Y 0 → +40

## Longform 16:9 Finishing Stage:
1. **Aspect Ratio**: 16:9 Landscape (1920×1080).
2. **Motion Varieties**: Rotate across 10 motion patterns (Zoom In, Zoom Out, Move Left/Right/Up/Down, Zoom + Move combinations).
3. **Transitions**: 0.5s crossfades or dips-to-black.
4. **Subtitles**: Capped at **maximum 8 words appearing at a time** (can be fewer based on natural speech beats and pauses), positioned cleanly in the lower third.

skills.name: Viral Pacing & Hook Retention
skills.activity: Pacing, hook trimming, silence removal, and cut frequency
skills.description: Enforces rapid hook retention, tight jump-cut pacing, and micro-trimming of breath pauses for high watch-time.

workflow.title: Hook Optimization (First 3s)
workflow.instruction: Cut initial shot durations to 0.8s–1.4s maximum. Apply 1.15x punch zoom on first emphasized word.

workflow.title: Dialogue Silence Trimming
workflow.instruction: Trim dead air over 0.35s on A-Roll voice track.
workflow.decisionRule: Choose L-cut if speech continues into B-Roll, otherwise snap ripple cut without gaps.

skills.editingRules:
# Pacing & Trimming Execution Rules
1. Keep individual shot durations between 0.8s and 1.4s during the first 3s hook.
2. Cut dead air over 0.35s on voice track.

B3 We find ourselves trapped in recurring cycles, mistaking conditioning for authentic destiny. ## B4 Until a sudden realization shatters the illusion, revealing that the cage door was unlocked the entire time. ##

B5 In a dim childhood bedroom with warm nostalgic light filtering through cracked blinds, the truth becomes clear. ## B6 Breaking through the barrier demands radical editorial courage and intentional cognitive reframing. ##

B7 When modern neuroscience merges with timeless philosophical stoicism, clarity replaces paralysis. ## B8 This is the actionable blueprint: observe the impulse, dismantle the reflex, and architect your reality.

skills.editingRules:
# Silent Strategist Skill — Core Matching Workflow

This describes the foundation stage of the Silent Strategist Skill: turning a script, a set of images, and a voiceover audio file into a fully sequenced and timed video with OpenAI Whisper STT, AI thinking reasoning, motion varieties, and tailored subtitle formatting.

## Step 1: Check Inputs & AI Agent Thinking Process
Confirm that all three required inputs are received: script text, image files, and voiceover audio track. The AI Agent enters a structured thinking state (reasoning through input validation, acoustic waveform analysis, and sequence alignment before execution).

## Step 2: OpenAI Whisper STT Word-Level Transcription
Run the voiceover audio through OpenAI Whisper STT (Large-v3 / API) configured for forced alignment to return word-level timestamps (exact start and end time of every individual spoken word).

## Step 3: Match Images to Script Anchor Phrases
Each image's filename is a short anchor phrase (typically the first ~5 words of a sentence in the script). Search the script text to locate each image's anchor phrase sequentially. The remaining words in a sentence belong to that same image until the next anchor phrase begins.

## Step 4: Sequence the Images
Order images in the exact order their anchor phrases appear in the script from start to finish.

## Step 5: Assign Timing to Each Image using Whisper
Set each image's start time to the Whisper timestamp where its anchor phrase begins being spoken. Set end time to where the next anchor phrase starts.

## Step 6: Confirm Full Timed Sequence
Ensure zero gaps and continuous timeline coverage from start to finish.

## Step 7: Apply Rich Motion Varieties
Cycle clips through diverse motion varieties:
1. **Zoom In**: Scale 1.00 → 1.18
2. **Zoom Out**: Scale 1.20 → 1.00
3. **Move Left**: Pan X +35 → -35
4. **Move Right**: Pan X -35 → +35
5. **Move Up**: Tilt Y +35 → -35
6. **Move Down**: Tilt Y -35 → +35
7. **Zoom & Move Left**: Scale 1.00 → 1.22 + Pan X 0 → -40
8. **Zoom & Move Right**: Scale 1.00 → 1.22 + Pan X 0 → +40
9. **Zoom & Move Up**: Scale 1.00 → 1.22 + Tilt Y 0 → -40
10. **Zoom & Move Down**: Scale 1.00 → 1.22 + Tilt Y 0 → +40

## Longform 16:9 Finishing Stage:
1. **Aspect Ratio**: 16:9 Landscape (1920×1080).
2. **Motion Varieties**: Rotate across 10 motion patterns (Zoom In, Zoom Out, Move Left/Right/Up/Down, Zoom + Move combinations).
3. **Transitions**: 0.5s crossfades or dips-to-black.
4. **Subtitles**: Capped at **maximum 8 words appearing at a time** (can be fewer based on natural speech beats and pauses), positioned cleanly in the lower third.

skills.activity: Pacing, hook trimming, silence removal, and cut frequency
skills.description: Enforces rapid hook retention, tight jump-cut pacing, and micro-trimming of breath pauses for high watch-time.

workflow.title: Hook Optimization (First 3s)
workflow.instruction: Cut initial shot durations to 0.8s–1.4s maximum. Apply 1.15x punch zoom on first emphasized word.

workflow.title: Dialogue Silence Trimming
workflow.instruction: Trim dead air over 0.35s on A-Roll voice track.
workflow.decisionRule: Choose L-cut if speech continues into B-Roll, otherwise snap ripple cut without gaps.

skills.description: Sequences images to voiceover audio using Whisper STT & anchor phrases for 9:16 shortform videos with punch zooms & word-by-word kinetic captions.

workflow.title: Check Inputs & AI Agent Thinking Initialization
workflow.instruction: Confirm script (text), images (anchor phrase filenames), and audio (voiceover) are all present. AI Agent enters step-by-step thinking & validation mode.

workflow.title: Connect to OpenAI Whisper STT for Word-Level Transcription
workflow.instruction: Run voiceover audio through OpenAI Whisper STT (Large-v3 engine) to extract word-level speech timestamps (exact start/end time of every spoken word).

workflow.title: Match Images to Script Anchors
workflow.instruction: Extract anchor phrases from image filenames (~first 5 words of sentence). Search script text sequentially for exact/near-exact matches.

workflow.title: Sequence Images
workflow.instruction: Order image clips according to the exact sequence their matched anchor phrases appear in the script text from start to finish.

workflow.title: Assign Timing to Each Image
workflow.instruction: Set image start time to Whisper audio timestamp where anchor phrase begins. Set end time to timestamp where next anchor phrase starts.

workflow.title: Confirm Full Timed Sequence
workflow.instruction: Verify every image has a precise start time, end time, and continuous timeline position derived from script text and Whisper speech audio.

workflow.title: Apply 9:16 Shortform Motion Varieties, Whip Cuts & Kinetic Captions
workflow.instruction: Apply 9:16 vertical framing, cycle motion varieties (Zoom In, Zoom Out, Move L/R/U/D, Zoom & Move), fast whip cuts, and word-by-word kinetic karaoke captions.
workflow.decisionRule: Maintain high-retention 9:16 vertical pacing with word-by-word kinetic karaoke captions.

skills.editingRules:
# Silent Strategist Skill — Core Matching Workflow

This describes the foundation stage of the Silent Strategist Skill: turning a script, a set of images, and a voiceover audio file into a fully sequenced and timed video with OpenAI Whisper STT, AI thinking reasoning, motion varieties, and tailored subtitle formatting.

## Step 1: Check Inputs & AI Agent Thinking Process
Confirm that all three required inputs are received: script text, image files, and voiceover audio track. The AI Agent enters a structured thinking state (reasoning through input validation, acoustic waveform analysis, and sequence alignment before execution).

## Step 2: OpenAI Whisper STT Word-Level Transcription
Run the voiceover audio through OpenAI Whisper STT (Large-v3 / API) configured for forced alignment to return word-level timestamps (exact start and end time of every individual spoken word).

## Step 3: Match Images to Script Anchor Phrases
Each image's filename is a short anchor phrase (typically the first ~5 words of a sentence in the script). Search the script text to locate each image's anchor phrase sequentially. The remaining words in a sentence belong to that same image until the next anchor phrase begins.

## Step 4: Sequence the Images
Order images in the exact order their anchor phrases appear in the script from start to finish.

## Step 5: Assign Timing to Each Image using Whisper
Set each image's start time to the Whisper timestamp where its anchor phrase begins being spoken. Set end time to where the next anchor phrase starts.

## Step 6: Confirm Full Timed Sequence
Ensure zero gaps and continuous timeline coverage from start to finish.

## Step 7: Apply Rich Motion Varieties
Cycle clips through diverse motion varieties:
1. **Zoom In**: Scale 1.00 → 1.18
2. **Zoom Out**: Scale 1.20 → 1.00
3. **Move Left**: Pan X +35 → -35
4. **Move Right**: Pan X -35 → +35
5. **Move Up**: Tilt Y +35 → -35
6. **Move Down**: Tilt Y -35 → +35
7. **Zoom & Move Left**: Scale 1.00 → 1.22 + Pan X 0 → -40
8. **Zoom & Move Right**: Scale 1.00 → 1.22 + Pan X 0 → +40
9. **Zoom & Move Up**: Scale 1.00 → 1.22 + Tilt Y 0 → -40
10. **Zoom & Move Down**: Scale 1.00 → 1.22 + Tilt Y 0 → +40

## Shortform 9:16 Finishing Stage:
1. **Aspect Ratio**: 9:16 Vertical (1080×1920).
2. **Motion Varieties**: Rotate across 10 motion patterns (Zoom In, Zoom Out, Move Left/Right/Up/Down, Zoom + Move combinations).
3. **Transitions**: Fast 0.2s whip zooms or instant hard cuts.
4. **Subtitles**: **Word-by-word kinetic karaoke captions** anchored in the middle mobile safe zone.

skills.name: Viral Pacing & Hook Retention
skills.activity: Pacing, hook trimming, silence removal, and cut frequency
skills.description: Enforces rapid hook retention, tight jump-cut pacing, and micro-trimming of breath pauses for high watch-time.

workflow.title: Hook Optimization (First 3s)
workflow.instruction: Cut initial shot durations to 0.8s–1.4s maximum. Apply 1.15x punch zoom on first emphasized word.

workflow.title: Dialogue Silence Trimming
workflow.instruction: Trim dead air over 0.35s on A-Roll voice track.
workflow.decisionRule: Choose L-cut if speech continues into B-Roll, otherwise snap ripple cut without gaps.

skills.editingRules:
# Pacing & Trimming Execution Rules
1. Keep individual shot durations between 0.8s and 1.4s during the first 3s hook.
2. Cut dead air over 0.35s on voice track.

Confirm that all three required inputs are received: script text, image files, and voiceover audio track. The AI Agent enters a structured thinking state (reasoning through input validation, acoustic waveform analysis, and sequence alignment before execution).

## Step 2: OpenAI Whisper STT Word-Level Transcription
Run the voiceover audio through OpenAI Whisper STT (Large-v3 / API) configured for forced alignment to return word-level timestamps (exact start and end time of every individual spoken word).

## Step 3: Match Images to Script Anchor Phrases
Each image's filename is a short anchor phrase (typically the first ~5 words of a sentence in the script). Search the script text to locate each image's anchor phrase sequentially. The remaining words in a sentence belong to that same image until the next anchor phrase begins.

## Step 4: Sequence the Images
Order images in the exact order their anchor phrases appear in the script from start to finish.

## Step 5: Assign Timing to Each Image using Whisper
Set each image's start time to the Whisper timestamp where its anchor phrase begins being spoken. Set end time to where the next anchor phrase starts.

## Step 6: Confirm Full Timed Sequence
Ensure zero gaps and continuous timeline coverage from start to finish.

## Step 7: Apply Rich Motion Varieties
Cycle clips through diverse motion varieties:
1. **Zoom In**: Scale 1.00 → 1.18
2. **Zoom Out**: Scale 1.20 → 1.00
3. **Move Left**: Pan X +35 → -35
4. **Move Right**: Pan X -35 → +35
5. **Move Up**: Tilt Y +35 → -35
6. **Move Down**: Tilt Y -35 → +35
7. **Zoom & Move Left**: Scale 1.00 → 1.22 + Pan X 0 → -40
8. **Zoom & Move Right**: Scale 1.00 → 1.22 + Pan X 0 → +40

B3 We find ourselves trapped in recurring cycles, mistaking conditioning for authentic destiny. ## B4 Until a sudden realization shatters the illusion, revealing that the cage door was unlocked the entire time. ##

B5 In a dim childhood bedroom with warm nostalgic light filtering through cracked blinds, the truth becomes clear. ## B6 Breaking through the barrier demands radical editorial courage and intentional cognitive reframing. ##

B7 When modern neuroscience merges with timeless philosophical stoicism, clarity replaces paralysis. ## B8 This is the actionable blueprint: observe the impulse, dismantle the reflex, and architect your reality.

skills.editingRules:
# Silent Strategist Skill — Core Matching Workflow

This describes the foundation stage of the Silent Strategist Skill: turning a script, a set of images, and a voiceover audio file into a fully sequenced and timed video with OpenAI Whisper STT, AI thinking reasoning, motion varieties, and tailored subtitle formatting.

## Step 1: Check Inputs & AI Agent Thinking Process
Confirm that all three required inputs are received: script text, image files, and voiceover audio track. The AI Agent enters a structured thinking state (reasoning through input validation, acoustic waveform analysis, and sequence alignment before execution).

## Step 2: OpenAI Whisper STT Word-Level Transcription
Run the voiceover audio through OpenAI Whisper STT (Large-v3 / API) configured for forced alignment to return word-level timestamps (exact start and end time of every individual spoken word).

## Step 3: Match Images to Script Anchor Phrases
Each image's filename is a short anchor phrase (typically the first ~5 words of a sentence in the script). Search the script text to locate each image's anchor phrase sequentially. The remaining words in a sentence belong to that same image until the next anchor phrase begins.

## Step 4: Sequence the Images
Order images in the exact order their anchor phrases appear in the script from start to finish.

## Step 5: Assign Timing to Each Image using Whisper
Set each image's start time to the Whisper timestamp where its anchor phrase begins being spoken. Set end time to where the next anchor phrase starts.

## Step 6: Confirm Full Timed Sequence
Ensure zero gaps and continuous timeline coverage from start to finish.

## Step 7: Apply Rich Motion Varieties
Cycle clips through diverse motion varieties:
1. **Zoom In**: Scale 1.00 → 1.18
2. **Zoom Out**: Scale 1.20 → 1.00
3. **Move Left**: Pan X +35 → -35
4. **Move Right**: Pan X -35 → +35
5. **Move Up**: Tilt Y +35 → -35
6. **Move Down**: Tilt Y -35 → +35
7. **Zoom & Move Left**: Scale 1.00 → 1.22 + Pan X 0 → -40
8. **Zoom & Move Right**: Scale 1.00 → 1.22 + Pan X 0 → +40
9. **Zoom & Move Up**: Scale 1.00 → 1.22 + Tilt Y 0 → -40
10. **Zoom & Move Down**: Scale 1.00 → 1.22 + Tilt Y 0 → +40

## Longform 16:9 Finishing Stage:
1. **Aspect Ratio**: 16:9 Landscape (1920×1080).
2. **Motion Varieties**: Rotate across 10 motion patterns (Zoom In, Zoom Out, Move Left/Right/Up/Down, Zoom + Move combinations).
3. **Transitions**: 0.5s crossfades or dips-to-black.
4. **Subtitles**: Capped at **maximum 8 words appearing at a time** (can be fewer based on natural speech beats and pauses), positioned cleanly in the lower third.

skills.name: Viral Pacing & Hook Retention
skills.activity: Pacing, hook trimming, silence removal, and cut frequency
skills.description: Enforces rapid hook retention, tight jump-cut pacing, and micro-trimming of breath pauses for high watch-time.

workflow.title: Hook Optimization (First 3s)
workflow.instruction: Cut initial shot durations to 0.8s–1.4s maximum. Apply 1.15x punch zoom on first emphasized word.

workflow.title: Dialogue Silence Trimming
workflow.instruction: Trim dead air over 0.35s on A-Roll voice track.
workflow.decisionRule: Choose L-cut if speech continues into B-Roll, otherwise snap ripple cut without gaps.

skills.editingRules:
# Silent Strategist Skill — Core Matching Workflow

This describes the foundation stage of the Silent Strategist Skill: turning a script, a set of images, and a voiceover audio file into a fully sequenced and timed video with OpenAI Whisper STT, AI thinking reasoning, motion varieties, and tailored subtitle formatting.

## Step 1: Check Inputs & AI Agent Thinking Process
Confirm that all three required inputs are received: script text, image files, and voiceover audio track. The AI Agent enters a structured thinking state (reasoning through input validation, acoustic waveform analysis, and sequence alignment before execution).

## Step 2: OpenAI Whisper STT Word-Level Transcription
Run the voiceover audio through OpenAI Whisper STT (Large-v3 / API) configured for forced alignment to return word-level timestamps (exact start and end time of every individual spoken word).

## Step 3: Match Images to Script Anchor Phrases
Each image's filename is a short anchor phrase (typically the first ~5 words of a sentence in the script). Search the script text to locate each image's anchor phrase sequentially. The remaining words in a sentence belong to that same image until the next anchor phrase begins.

## Step 4: Sequence the Images
Order images in the exact order their anchor phrases appear in the script from start to finish.

## Step 5: Assign Timing to Each Image using Whisper
Set each image's start time to the Whisper timestamp where its anchor phrase begins being spoken. Set end time to where the next anchor phrase starts.

## Step 6: Confirm Full Timed Sequence
Ensure zero gaps and continuous timeline coverage from start to finish.

## Step 7: Apply Rich Motion Varieties
Cycle clips through diverse motion varieties:
1. **Zoom In**: Scale 1.00 → 1.18
2. **Zoom Out**: Scale 1.20 → 1.00
3. **Move Left**: Pan X +35 → -35
4. **Move Right**: Pan X -35 → +35
5. **Move Up**: Tilt Y +35 → -35
6. **Move Down**: Tilt Y -35 → +35
7. **Zoom & Move Left**: Scale 1.00 → 1.22 + Pan X 0 → -40
8. **Zoom & Move Right**: Scale 1.00 → 1.22 + Pan X 0 → +40
9. **Zoom & Move Up**: Scale 1.00 → 1.22 + Tilt Y 0 → -40
10. **Zoom & Move Down**: Scale 1.00 → 1.22 + Tilt Y 0 → +40

## Longform 16:9 Finishing Stage:
1. **Aspect Ratio**: 16:9 Landscape (1920×1080).
2. **Motion Varieties**: Rotate across 10 motion patterns (Zoom In, Zoom Out, Move Left/Right/Up/Down, Zoom + Move combinations).
3. **Transitions**: 0.5s crossfades or dips-to-black.
4. **Subtitles**: Capped at **maximum 8 words appearing at a time** (can be fewer based on natural speech beats and pauses), positioned cleanly in the lower third.

B7 When modern neuroscience merges with timeless philosophical stoicism, clarity replaces paralysis. ## B8 This is the actionable blueprint: observe the impulse, dismantle the reflex, and architect your reality.

skills.editingRules:
# Silent Strategist Skill — Core Matching Workflow

This describes the foundation stage of the Silent Strategist Skill: turning a script, a set of images, and a voiceover audio file into a fully sequenced and timed video with OpenAI Whisper STT, AI thinking reasoning, motion varieties, and tailored subtitle formatting.

## Step 1: Check Inputs & AI Agent Thinking Process
Confirm that all three required inputs are received: script text, image files, and voiceover audio track. The AI Agent enters a structured thinking state (reasoning through input validation, acoustic waveform analysis, and sequence alignment before execution).

## Step 2: OpenAI Whisper STT Word-Level Transcription
Run the voiceover audio through OpenAI Whisper STT (Large-v3 / API) configured for forced alignment to return word-level timestamps (exact start and end time of every individual spoken word).

## Step 3: Match Images to Script Anchor Phrases
Each image's filename is a short anchor phrase (typically the first ~5 words of a sentence in the script). Search the script text to locate each image's anchor phrase sequentially. The remaining words in a sentence belong to that same image until the next anchor phrase begins.

## Step 4: Sequence the Images
Order images in the exact order their anchor phrases appear in the script from start to finish.

## Step 5: Assign Timing to Each Image using Whisper
Set each image's start time to the Whisper timestamp where its anchor phrase begins being spoken. Set end time to where the next anchor phrase starts.

## Step 6: Confirm Full Timed Sequence
Ensure zero gaps and continuous timeline coverage from start to finish.

## Step 7: Apply Rich Motion Varieties
Cycle clips through diverse motion varieties:
1. **Zoom In**: Scale 1.00 → 1.18
2. **Zoom Out**: Scale 1.20 → 1.00
3. **Move Left**: Pan X +35 → -35
4. **Move Right**: Pan X -35 → +35
5. **Move Up**: Tilt Y +35 → -35
6. **Move Down**: Tilt Y -35 → +35
7. **Zoom & Move Left**: Scale 1.00 → 1.22 + Pan X 0 → -40
8. **Zoom & Move Right**: Scale 1.00 → 1.22 + Pan X 0 → +40
9. **Zoom & Move Up**: Scale 1.00 → 1.22 + Tilt Y 0 → -40
10. **Zoom & Move Down**: Scale 1.00 → 1.22 + Tilt Y 0 → +40

## Longform 16:9 Finishing Stage:
1. **Aspect Ratio**: 16:9 Landscape (1920×1080).
2. **Motion Varieties**: Rotate across 10 motion patterns (Zoom In, Zoom Out, Move Left/Right/Up/Down, Zoom + Move combinations).
3. **Transitions**: 0.5s crossfades or dips-to-black.
4. **Subtitles**: Capped at **maximum 8 words appearing at a time** (can be fewer based on natural speech beats and pauses), positioned cleanly in the lower third.

skills.editingRules:
# Silent Strategist Skill — Core Matching Workflow

This describes the foundation stage of the Silent Strategist Skill: turning a script, a set of images, and a voiceover audio file into a fully sequenced and timed video with OpenAI Whisper STT, AI thinking reasoning, motion varieties, and tailored subtitle formatting.

## Step 1: Check Inputs & AI Agent Thinking Process
Confirm that all three required inputs are received: script text, image files, and voiceover audio track. The AI Agent enters a structured thinking state (reasoning through input validation, acoustic waveform analysis, and sequence alignment before execution).

## Step 2: OpenAI Whisper STT Word-Level Transcription
Run the voiceover audio through OpenAI Whisper STT (Large-v3 / API) configured for forced alignment to return word-level timestamps (exact start and end time of every individual spoken word).

## Step 3: Match Images to Script Anchor Phrases
Each image's filename is a short anchor phrase (typically the first ~5 words of a sentence in the script). Search the script text to locate each image's anchor phrase sequentially. The remaining words in a sentence belong to that same image until the next anchor phrase begins.

## Step 4: Sequence the Images
Order images in the exact order their anchor phrases appear in the script from start to finish.

## Step 5: Assign Timing to Each Image using Whisper
Set each image's start time to the Whisper timestamp where its anchor phrase begins being spoken. Set end time to where the next anchor phrase starts.

## Step 6: Confirm Full Timed Sequence
Ensure zero gaps and continuous timeline coverage from start to finish.

## Step 7: Apply Rich Motion Varieties
Cycle clips through diverse motion varieties:
1. **Zoom In**: Scale 1.00 → 1.18
2. **Zoom Out**: Scale 1.20 → 1.00
3. **Move Left**: Pan X +35 → -35
4. **Move Right**: Pan X -35 → +35
5. **Move Up**: Tilt Y +35 → -35
6. **Move Down**: Tilt Y -35 → +35
7. **Zoom & Move Left**: Scale 1.00 → 1.22 + Pan X 0 → -40
8. **Zoom & Move Right**: Scale 1.00 → 1.22 + Pan X 0 → +40
9. **Zoom & Move Up**: Scale 1.00 → 1.22 + Tilt Y 0 → -40
10. **Zoom & Move Down**: Scale 1.00 → 1.22 + Tilt Y 0 → +40

## Shortform 9:16 Finishing Stage:
1. **Aspect Ratio**: 9:16 Vertical (1080×1920).
2. **Motion Varieties**: Rotate across 10 motion patterns (Zoom In, Zoom Out, Move Left/Right/Up/Down, Zoom + Move combinations).
3. **Transitions**: Fast 0.2s whip zooms or instant hard cuts.
4. **Subtitles**: **Word-by-word kinetic karaoke captions** anchored in the middle mobile safe zone.

skills.name: Viral Pacing & Hook Retention
skills.activity: Pacing, hook trimming, silence removal, and cut frequency
skills.description: Enforces rapid hook retention, tight jump-cut pacing, and micro-trimming of breath pauses for high watch-time.

workflow.title: Hook Optimization (First 3s)
workflow.instruction: Cut initial shot durations to 0.8s–1.4s maximum. Apply 1.15x punch zoom on first emphasized word.

workflow.title: Dialogue Silence Trimming
workflow.instruction: Trim dead air over 0.35s on A-Roll voice track.
workflow.decisionRule: Choose L-cut if speech continues into B-Roll, otherwise snap ripple cut without gaps.

skills.editingRules:

2. Cut dead air over 0.35s on voice track.

Confirm that all three required inputs are received: script text, image files, and voiceover audio track. The AI Agent enters a structured thinking state (reasoning through input validation, acoustic waveform analysis, and sequence alignment before execution).

## Step 2: OpenAI Whisper STT Word-Level Transcription
Run the voiceover audio through OpenAI Whisper STT (Large-v3 / API) configured for forced alignment to return word-level timestamps (exact start and end time of every individual spoken word).

## Step 3: Match Images to Script Anchor Phrases
Each image's filename is a short anchor phrase (typically the first ~5 words of a sentence in the script). Search the script text to locate each image's anchor phrase sequentially. The remaining words in a sentence belong to that same image until the next anchor phrase begins.

## Step 4: Sequence the Images
Order images in the exact order their anchor phrases appear in the script from start to finish.

## Step 5: Assign Timing to Each Image using Whisper
Set each image's start time to the Whisper timestamp where its anchor phrase begins being spoken. Set end time to where the next anchor phrase starts.

## Step 6: Confirm Full Timed Sequence
Ensure zero gaps and continuous timeline coverage from start to finish.

## Step 7: Apply Rich Motion Varieties
Cycle clips through diverse motion varieties:
1. **Zoom In**: Scale 1.00 → 1.18
2. **Zoom Out**: Scale 1.20 → 1.00
3. **Move Left**: Pan X +35 → -35
4. **Move Right**: Pan X -35 → +35
5. **Move Up**: Tilt Y +35 → -35
6. **Move Down**: Tilt Y -35 → +35
7. **Zoom & Move Left**: Scale 1.00 → 1.22 + Pan X 0 → -40
8. **Zoom & Move Right**: Scale 1.00 → 1.22 + Pan X 0 → +40
9. **Zoom & Move Up**: Scale 1.00 → 1.22 + Tilt Y 0 → -40
10. **Zoom & Move Down**: Scale 1.00 → 1.22 + Tilt Y 0 → +40

1. **Aspect Ratio**: 16:9 Landscape (1920×1080).

4. **Subtitles**: Capped at **maximum 8 words appearing at a time** (can be fewer based on natural speech beats and pauses), positioned cleanly in the lower third.

skills.editingRules:
# Silent Strategist Skill — Core Matching Workflow

This describes the foundation stage of the Silent Strategist Skill: turning a script, a set of images, and a voiceover audio file into a fully sequenced and timed video with OpenAI Whisper STT, AI thinking reasoning, motion varieties, and tailored subtitle formatting.

## Step 1: Check Inputs & AI Agent Thinking Process
Confirm that all three required inputs are received: script text, image files, and voiceover audio track. The AI Agent enters a structured thinking state (reasoning through input validation, acoustic waveform analysis, and sequence alignment before execution).

## Step 2: OpenAI Whisper STT Word-Level Transcription
Run the voiceover audio through OpenAI Whisper STT (Large-v3 / API) configured for forced alignment to return word-level timestamps (exact start and end time of every individual spoken word).

## Step 3: Match Images to Script Anchor Phrases
Each image's filename is a short anchor phrase (typically the first ~5 words of a sentence in the script). Search the script text to locate each image's anchor phrase sequentially. The remaining words in a sentence belong to that same image until the next anchor phrase begins.

## Step 4: Sequence the Images
Order images in the exact order their anchor phrases appear in the script from start to finish.

## Step 5: Assign Timing to Each Image using Whisper
Set each image's start time to the Whisper timestamp where its anchor phrase begins being spoken. Set end time to where the next anchor phrase starts.

## Step 6: Confirm Full Timed Sequence
Ensure zero gaps and continuous timeline coverage from start to finish.

## Step 7: Apply Rich Motion Varieties
Cycle clips through diverse motion varieties:
1. **Zoom In**: Scale 1.00 → 1.18
2. **Zoom Out**: Scale 1.20 → 1.00
3. **Move Left**: Pan X +35 → -35
4. **Move Right**: Pan X -35 → +35
5. **Move Up**: Tilt Y +35 → -35
6. **Move Down**: Tilt Y -35 → +35
7. **Zoom & Move Left**: Scale 1.00 → 1.22 + Pan X 0 → -40
8. **Zoom & Move Right**: Scale 1.00 → 1.22 + Pan X 0 → +40
9. **Zoom & Move Up**: Scale 1.00 → 1.22 + Tilt Y 0 → -40
10. **Zoom & Move Down**: Scale 1.00 → 1.22 + Tilt Y 0 → +40

## Longform 16:9 Finishing Stage:
1. **Aspect Ratio**: 16:9 Landscape (1920×1080).
2. **Motion Varieties**: Rotate across 10 motion patterns (Zoom In, Zoom Out, Move Left/Right/Up/Down, Zoom + Move combinations).
3. **Transitions**: 0.5s crossfades or dips-to-black.
4. **Subtitles**: Capped at **maximum 8 words appearing at a time** (can be fewer based on natural speech beats and pauses), positioned cleanly in the lower third.

skills.name: Viral Pacing & Hook Retention
skills.activity: Pacing, hook trimming, silence removal, and cut frequency
skills.description: Enforces rapid hook retention, tight jump-cut pacing, and micro-trimming of breath pauses for high watch-time.

workflow.title: Hook Optimization (First 3s)
workflow.instruction: Cut initial shot durations to 0.8s–1.4s maximum. Apply 1.15x punch zoom on first emphasized word.

workflow.title: Dialogue Silence Trimming
workflow.instruction: Trim dead air over 0.35s on A-Roll voice track.
workflow.decisionRule: Choose L-cut if speech continues into B-Roll, otherwise snap ripple cut without gaps.

# Silent Strategist Skill — Core Matching Workflow

This describes the foundation stage of the Silent Strategist Skill: turning a script, a set of images, and a voiceover audio file into a fully sequenced and timed video with OpenAI Whisper STT, AI thinking reasoning, motion varieties, and tailored subtitle formatting.

## Step 1: Check Inputs & AI Agent Thinking Process
Confirm that all three required inputs are received: script text, image files, and voiceover audio track. The AI Agent enters a structured thinking state (reasoning through input validation, acoustic waveform analysis, and sequence alignment before execution).

## Step 2: OpenAI Whisper STT Word-Level Transcription
Run the voiceover audio through OpenAI Whisper STT (Large-v3 / API) configured for forced alignment to return word-level timestamps (exact start and end time of every individual spoken word).

## Step 3: Match Images to Script Anchor Phrases
Each image's filename is a short anchor phrase (typically the first ~5 words of a sentence in the script). Search the script text to locate each image's anchor phrase sequentially. The remaining words in a sentence belong to that same image until the next anchor phrase begins.

## Step 4: Sequence the Images
Order images in the exact order their anchor phrases appear in the script from start to finish.

## Step 5: Assign Timing to Each Image using Whisper
Set each image's start time to the Whisper timestamp where its anchor phrase begins being spoken. Set end time to where the next anchor phrase starts.

## Step 6: Confirm Full Timed Sequence
Ensure zero gaps and continuous timeline coverage from start to finish.

## Step 7: Apply Rich Motion Varieties
Cycle clips through diverse motion varieties:
1. **Zoom In**: Scale 1.00 → 1.18
2. **Zoom Out**: Scale 1.20 → 1.00
3. **Move Left**: Pan X +35 → -35
4. **Move Right**: Pan X -35 → +35
5. **Move Up**: Tilt Y +35 → -35
6. **Move Down**: Tilt Y -35 → +35
7. **Zoom & Move Left**: Scale 1.00 → 1.22 + Pan X 0 → -40
8. **Zoom & Move Right**: Scale 1.00 → 1.22 + Pan X 0 → +40
9. **Zoom & Move Up**: Scale 1.00 → 1.22 + Tilt Y 0 → -40
10. **Zoom & Move Down**: Scale 1.00 → 1.22 + Tilt Y 0 → +40

## Longform 16:9 Finishing Stage:
1. **Aspect Ratio**: 16:9 Landscape (1920×1080).
2. **Motion Varieties**: Rotate across 10 motion patterns (Zoom In, Zoom Out, Move Left/Right/Up/Down, Zoom + Move combinations).
3. **Transitions**: 0.5s crossfades or dips-to-black.
4. **Subtitles**: Capped at **maximum 8 words appearing at a time** (can be fewer based on natural speech beats and pauses), positioned cleanly in the lower third.

# Silent Strategist Skill — Core Matching Workflow

This describes the foundation stage of the Silent Strategist Skill: turning a script, a set of images, and a voiceover audio file into a fully sequenced and timed video with OpenAI Whisper STT, AI thinking reasoning, motion varieties, and tailored subtitle formatting.

## Step 1: Check Inputs & AI Agent Thinking Process
Confirm that all three required inputs are received: script text, image files, and voiceover audio track. The AI Agent enters a structured thinking state (reasoning through input validation, acoustic waveform analysis, and sequence alignment before execution).

## Step 2: OpenAI Whisper STT Word-Level Transcription
Run the voiceover audio through OpenAI Whisper STT (Large-v3 / API) configured for forced alignment to return word-level timestamps (exact start and end time of every individual spoken word).

## Step 3: Match Images to Script Anchor Phrases
Each image's filename is a short anchor phrase (typically the first ~5 words of a sentence in the script). Search the script text to locate each image's anchor phrase sequentially. The remaining words in a sentence belong to that same image until the next anchor phrase begins.

## Step 4: Sequence the Images
Order images in the exact order their anchor phrases appear in the script from start to finish.

## Step 5: Assign Timing to Each Image using Whisper
Set each image's start time to the Whisper timestamp where its anchor phrase begins being spoken. Set end time to where the next anchor phrase starts.

## Step 6: Confirm Full Timed Sequence
Ensure zero gaps and continuous timeline coverage from start to finish.

## Step 7: Apply Rich Motion Varieties
Cycle clips through diverse motion varieties:
1. **Zoom In**: Scale 1.00 → 1.18
2. **Zoom Out**: Scale 1.20 → 1.00
3. **Move Left**: Pan X +35 → -35
4. **Move Right**: Pan X -35 → +35
5. **Move Up**: Tilt Y +35 → -35
6. **Move Down**: Tilt Y -35 → +35
7. **Zoom & Move Left**: Scale 1.00 → 1.22 + Pan X 0 → -40
8. **Zoom & Move Right**: Scale 1.00 → 1.22 + Pan X 0 → +40
9. **Zoom & Move Up**: Scale 1.00 → 1.22 + Tilt Y 0 → -40
10. **Zoom & Move Down**: Scale 1.00 → 1.22 + Tilt Y 0 → +40

# Silent Strategist Skill — Core Matching Workflow

This describes the foundation stage of the Silent Strategist Skill: turning a script, a set of images, and a voiceover audio file into a fully sequenced and timed video with OpenAI Whisper STT, AI thinking reasoning, motion varieties, and tailored subtitle formatting.

## Step 1: Check Inputs & AI Agent Thinking Process
Confirm that all three required inputs are received: script text, image files, and voiceover audio track. The AI Agent enters a structured thinking state (reasoning through input validation, acoustic waveform analysis, and sequence alignment before execution).

## Step 2: OpenAI Whisper STT Word-Level Transcription
Run the voiceover audio through OpenAI Whisper STT (Large-v3 / API) configured for forced alignment to return word-level timestamps (exact start and end time of every individual spoken word).

## Step 3: Match Images to Script Anchor Phrases
Each image's filename is a short anchor phrase (typically the first ~5 words of a sentence in the script). Search the script text to locate each image's anchor phrase sequentially. The remaining words in a sentence belong to that same image until the next anchor phrase begins.

## Step 4: Sequence the Images
Order images in the exact order their anchor phrases appear in the script from start to finish.

## Step 5: Assign Timing to Each Image using Whisper
Set each image's start time to the Whisper timestamp where its anchor phrase begins being spoken. Set end time to where the next anchor phrase starts.

## Step 6: Confirm Full Timed Sequence
Ensure zero gaps and continuous timeline coverage from start to finish.

## Step 7: Apply Rich Motion Varieties
Cycle clips through diverse motion varieties:
1. **Zoom In**: Scale 1.00 → 1.18
2. **Zoom Out**: Scale 1.20 → 1.00
3. **Move Left**: Pan X +35 → -35
4. **Move Right**: Pan X -35 → +35
5. **Move Up**: Tilt Y +35 → -35
6. **Move Down**: Tilt Y -35 → +35
7. **Zoom & Move Left**: Scale 1.00 → 1.22 + Pan X 0 → -40
8. **Zoom & Move Right**: Scale 1.00 → 1.22 + Pan X 0 → +40
9. **Zoom & Move Up**: Scale 1.00 → 1.22 + Tilt Y 0 → -40
10. **Zoom & Move Down**: Scale 1.00 → 1.22 + Tilt Y 0 → +40

## Longform 16:9 Finishing Stage:
1. **Aspect Ratio**: 16:9 Landscape (1920×1080).
2. **Motion Varieties**: Rotate across 10 motion patterns (Zoom In, Zoom Out, Move Left/Right/Up/Down, Zoom + Move combinations).
3. **Transitions**: 0.5s crossfades or dips-to-black.
4. **Subtitles**: Capped at **maximum 8 words appearing at a time** (can be fewer based on natural speech beats and pauses), positioned cleanly in the lower third.

B3 We find ourselves trapped in recurring cycles, mistaking conditioning for authentic destiny. ## B4 Until a sudden realization shatters the illusion, revealing that the cage door was unlocked the entire time. ##

# Silent Strategist Skill — Core Matching Workflow

This describes the foundation stage of the Silent Strategist Skill: turning a script, a set of images, and a voiceover audio file into a fully sequenced and timed video with OpenAI Whisper STT, AI thinking reasoning, motion varieties, and tailored subtitle formatting.

## Step 1: Check Inputs & AI Agent Thinking Process
Confirm that all three required inputs are received: script text, image files, and voiceover audio track. The AI Agent enters a structured thinking state (reasoning through input validation, acoustic waveform analysis, and sequence alignment before execution).

## Step 2: OpenAI Whisper STT Word-Level Transcription
Run the voiceover audio through OpenAI Whisper STT (Large-v3 / API) configured for forced alignment to return word-level timestamps (exact start and end time of every individual spoken word).

## Step 3: Match Images to Script Anchor Phrases
Each image's filename is a short anchor phrase (typically the first ~5 words of a sentence in the script). Search the script text to locate each image's anchor phrase sequentially. The remaining words in a sentence belong to that same image until the next anchor phrase begins.

## Step 4: Sequence the Images
Order images in the exact order their anchor phrases appear in the script from start to finish.

## Step 5: Assign Timing to Each Image using Whisper
Set each image's start time to the Whisper timestamp where its anchor phrase begins being spoken. Set end time to where the next anchor phrase starts.

## Step 6: Confirm Full Timed Sequence
Ensure zero gaps and continuous timeline coverage from start to finish.

## Step 7: Apply Rich Motion Varieties
Cycle clips through diverse motion varieties:
1. **Zoom In**: Scale 1.00 → 1.18
2. **Zoom Out**: Scale 1.20 → 1.00
3. **Move Left**: Pan X +35 → -35
4. **Move Right**: Pan X -35 → +35
5. **Move Up**: Tilt Y +35 → -35
6. **Move Down**: Tilt Y -35 → +35
7. **Zoom & Move Left**: Scale 1.00 → 1.22 + Pan X 0 → -40
8. **Zoom & Move Right**: Scale 1.00 → 1.22 + Pan X 0 → +40
9. **Zoom & Move Up**: Scale 1.00 → 1.22 + Tilt Y 0 → -40
10. **Zoom & Move Down**: Scale 1.00 → 1.22 + Tilt Y 0 → +40

## Longform 16:9 Finishing Stage:
1. **Aspect Ratio**: 16:9 Landscape (1920×1080).
2. **Motion Varieties**: Rotate across 10 motion patterns (Zoom In, Zoom Out, Move Left/Right/Up/Down, Zoom + Move combinations).
3. **Transitions**: 0.5s crossfades or dips-to-black.
4. **Subtitles**: Capped at **maximum 8 words appearing at a time** (can be fewer based on natural speech beats and pauses), positioned cleanly in the lower third.

Great question! It's always good to check our toolkit before we dive in. Right now, I've got a fantastic collection of images in the media bin, and I also see a voiceover audio track: 'people who hide feelings.wav'. That's a solid start for our visuals and sound!

What I'll really need to kick things off and bring this story to life is the **script text**. That's the backbone that helps me understand the narrative flow, match the right images to the spoken words, and then precisely time everything out. Also, knowing if we're aiming for a **longform (16:9 widescreen) or shortform (9:16 vertical) video** will help me apply the perfect pacing, motion, and subtitle style from the get-go.

So, if you can send over that script and let me know the desired format, we'll be in a perfect position to start building this piece!

here is the script

Here is my script context:
Picture a friend's kitchen that looks spotless — clean counters, calm quiet in the air. But on the stove sits a pressure cooker (a sealed pot that cooks using trapped steam), heat on high, safety valve shut tight. From outside, the room looks peaceful. Underneath, dangerous pressure builds against the metal walls.

This is what happens inside someone who hides their feelings. Society celebrates such people — quiet, dependable, calm in every crisis — and others envy that strength.

But psychology and neuroscience (the study of the brain and nervous system) tell a different story. Hiding feelings isn't emptiness — it's an active, exhausting effort, like holding a door shut against a raging storm. This piece looks behind that calm exterior: why people build these walls, what it costs their bodies, and how they can safely open up.



Psychologist James Gross's Process Model of Emotion Regulation shows emotions unfolding like a play: a situation happens, a person notices it, judges its meaning, then feels a response.

There are two ways to manage this play. The first is cognitive reappraisal — changing how a situation is interpreted before it upsets someone, like rewriting the script before the actors walk on stage. If a boss doesn't reply to an email, a person might assume he's simply busy. This activates the prefrontal cortex (the brain's decision-making region), calming the amygdala and insula (areas processing fear and bodily sensation), so the body stays relaxed.

People who hide their feelings rarely do this. Instead they rely on expressive suppression — letting the actor walk on stage boiling with rage, but forcing a smile and stillness. This happens late, after the emotion has already formed. The prefrontal cortex works overtime locking down the face and voice, but the amygdala and insula stay highly active underneath. The person looks calm; the brain is screaming.

This mismatch strains the body. The autonomic nervous system (which controls heart rate and stress response) goes into overdrive, predicting chronic physical complaints over time. Suppression also blunts the brain's reward system, dulling the ability to feel joy alongside pain — a kind of emotional grayness.


Nobody decides one day to start hiding feelings — it's usually a survival strategy learned in childhood.

Imagine a child forced into an adult's business suit, carrying a briefcase, managing grown-up problems because the adults at home are unavailable or overwhelmed. Family psychology calls this parentification — taking on adult responsibilities too early.

Such a child learns a painful rule: feelings are a burden. Crying is ignored, silence is praised as maturity. Their nervous system adapts through a dismissing-avoidant attachment style (a pattern where closeness feels unsafe): depending on others leads to disappointment, vulnerability to rejection.

As adults, they keep wearing that heavy suit, hardened into hyper-independence. They appear successful — tireless problem-solvers who never ask for help — but this is really a trauma scar. Asking for help triggers deep, primitive shame; needing something feels like a catastrophic loss of control.

Hey there! Great to connect. As your creative partner here, I'm ready to dive into shaping your story. To really get started and bring your vision to life, what I'd ideally need from you are the core ingredients of any compelling video:

1.  **Your Script:** This is the blueprint, the narrative backbone we'll build everything around.
2.  **Voiceover Audio:** If you have a voiceover, that's crucial for timing and pacing the visuals.
3.  **Visual Assets:** Whether they're images, video clips, or even just ideas for B-roll, these are what we'll be cutting together.

Right now, our timeline and media bin are completely clear – a blank canvas, which is exciting! So, whenever you're ready to share your script, audio, and visuals, let's load them up and start crafting something amazing together. What do you have in mind for us to begin with?

Here is my script context:
Picture a friend's kitchen that looks spotless — clean counters, calm quiet in the air. But on the stove sits a pressure cooker (a sealed pot that cooks using trapped steam), heat on high, safety valve shut tight. From outside, the room looks peaceful. Underneath, dangerous pressure builds against the metal walls.

This is what happens inside someone who hides their feelings. Society celebrates such people — quiet, dependable, calm in every crisis — and others envy that strength.

But psychology and neuroscience (the study of the brain and nervous system) tell a different story. Hiding feelings isn't emptiness — it's an active, exhausting effort, like holding a door shut against a raging storm. This piece looks behind that calm exterior: why people build these walls, what it costs their bodies, and how they can safely open up.



Psychologist James Gross's Process Model of Emotion Regulation shows emotions unfolding like a play: a situation happens, a person notices it, judges its meaning, then feels a response.

There are two ways to manage this play. The first is cognitive reappraisal — changing how a situation is interpreted before it upsets someone, like rewriting the script before the actors walk on stage. If a boss doesn't reply to an email, a person might assume he's simply busy. This activates the prefrontal cortex (the brain's decision-making region), calming the amygdala and insula (areas processing fear and bodily sensation), so the body stays relaxed.

People who hide their feelings rarely do this. Instead they rely on expressive suppression — letting the actor walk on stage boiling with rage, but forcing a smile and stillness. This happens late, after the emotion has already formed. The prefrontal cortex works overtime locking down the face and voice, but the amygdala and insula stay highly active underneath. The person looks calm; the brain is screaming.

This mismatch strains the body. The autonomic nervous system (which controls heart rate and stress response) goes into overdrive, predicting chronic physical complaints over time. Suppression also blunts the brain's reward system, dulling the ability to feel joy alongside pain — a kind of emotional grayness.


Nobody decides one day to start hiding feelings — it's usually a survival strategy learned in childhood.

Imagine a child forced into an adult's business suit, carrying a briefcase, managing grown-up problems because the adults at home are unavailable or overwhelmed. Family psychology calls this parentification — taking on adult responsibilities too early.

Such a child learns a painful rule: feelings are a burden. Crying is ignored, silence is praised as maturity. Their nervous system adapts through a dismissing-avoidant attachment style (a pattern where closeness feels unsafe): depending on others leads to disappointment, vulnerability to rejection.

As adults, they keep wearing that heavy suit, hardened into hyper-independence. They appear successful — tireless problem-solvers who never ask for help — but this is really a trauma scar. Asking for help triggers deep, primitive shame; needing something feels like a catastrophic loss of control.

# Silent Strategist Skill — Core Matching Workflow

This describes the foundation stage of the Silent Strategist Skill: turning a script, a set of images, and a voiceover audio file into a fully sequenced and timed video with OpenAI Whisper STT, AI thinking reasoning, motion varieties, and tailored subtitle formatting.

## Step 1: Check Inputs & AI Agent Thinking Process
Confirm that all three required inputs are received: script text, image files, and voiceover audio track. The AI Agent enters a structured thinking state (reasoning through input validation, acoustic waveform analysis, and sequence alignment before execution).

## Step 2: OpenAI Whisper STT Word-Level Transcription
Run the voiceover audio through OpenAI Whisper STT (Large-v3 / API) configured for forced alignment to return word-level timestamps (exact start and end time of every individual spoken word).

## Step 3: Match Images to Script Anchor Phrases
Each image's filename is a short anchor phrase (typically the first ~5 words of a sentence in the script). Search the script text to locate each image's anchor phrase sequentially. The remaining words in a sentence belong to that same image until the next anchor phrase begins.

## Step 4: Sequence the Images
Order images in the exact order their anchor phrases appear in the script from start to finish.

## Step 5: Assign Timing to Each Image using Whisper
Set each image's start time to the Whisper timestamp where its anchor phrase begins being spoken. Set end time to where the next anchor phrase starts.

## Step 6: Confirm Full Timed Sequence
Ensure zero gaps and continuous timeline coverage from start to finish.

## Step 7: Apply Rich Motion Varieties
Cycle clips through diverse motion varieties:
1. **Zoom In**: Scale 1.00 → 1.18
2. **Zoom Out**: Scale 1.20 → 1.00
3. **Move Left**: Pan X +35 → -35
4. **Move Right**: Pan X -35 → +35
5. **Move Up**: Tilt Y +35 → -35
6. **Move Down**: Tilt Y -35 → +35
7. **Zoom & Move Left**: Scale 1.00 → 1.22 + Pan X 0 → -40
8. **Zoom & Move Right**: Scale 1.00 → 1.22 + Pan X 0 → +40
9. **Zoom & Move Up**: Scale 1.00 → 1.22 + Tilt Y 0 → -40
10. **Zoom & Move Down**: Scale 1.00 → 1.22 + Tilt Y 0 → +40

## Longform 16:9 Finishing Stage:
1. **Aspect Ratio**: 16:9 Landscape (1920×1080).
2. **Motion Varieties**: Rotate across 10 motion patterns (Zoom In, Zoom Out, Move Left/Right/Up/Down, Zoom + Move combinations).
3. **Transitions**: 0.5s crossfades or dips-to-black.
4. **Subtitles**: Capped at **maximum 8 words appearing at a time** (can be fewer based on natural speech beats and pauses), positioned cleanly in the lower third.

# Silent Strategist Skill — Core Matching Workflow

This describes the foundation stage of the Silent Strategist Skill: turning a script, a set of images, and a voiceover audio file into a fully sequenced and timed video with OpenAI Whisper STT, AI thinking reasoning, motion varieties, and tailored subtitle formatting.

## Step 1: Check Inputs & AI Agent Thinking Process
Confirm that all three required inputs are received: script text, image files, and voiceover audio track. The AI Agent enters a structured thinking state (reasoning through input validation, acoustic waveform analysis, and sequence alignment before execution).

## Step 2: OpenAI Whisper STT Word-Level Transcription
Run the voiceover audio through OpenAI Whisper STT (Large-v3 / API) configured for forced alignment to return word-level timestamps (exact start and end time of every individual spoken word).

## Step 3: Match Images to Script Anchor Phrases
Each image's filename is a short anchor phrase (typically the first ~5 words of a sentence in the script). Search the script text to locate each image's anchor phrase sequentially. The remaining words in a sentence belong to that same image until the next anchor phrase begins.

## Step 4: Sequence the Images
Order images in the exact order their anchor phrases appear in the script from start to finish.

## Step 5: Assign Timing to Each Image using Whisper
Set each image's start time to the Whisper timestamp where its anchor phrase begins being spoken. Set end time to where the next anchor phrase starts.

## Step 6: Confirm Full Timed Sequence
Ensure zero gaps and continuous timeline coverage from start to finish.

## Step 7: Apply Rich Motion Varieties
Cycle clips through diverse motion varieties:
1. **Zoom In**: Scale 1.00 → 1.18
2. **Zoom Out**: Scale 1.20 → 1.00
3. **Move Left**: Pan X +35 → -35
4. **Move Right**: Pan X -35 → +35
5. **Move Up**: Tilt Y +35 → -35
6. **Move Down**: Tilt Y -35 → +35
7. **Zoom & Move Left**: Scale 1.00 → 1.22 + Pan X 0 → -40
8. **Zoom & Move Right**: Scale 1.00 → 1.22 + Pan X 0 → +40
9. **Zoom & Move Up**: Scale 1.00 → 1.22 + Tilt Y 0 → -40
10. **Zoom & Move Down**: Scale 1.00 → 1.22 + Tilt Y 0 → +40

## Longform 16:9 Finishing Stage:
1. **Aspect Ratio**: 16:9 Landscape (1920×1080).
2. **Motion Varieties**: Rotate across 10 motion patterns (Zoom In, Zoom Out, Move Left/Right/Up/Down, Zoom + Move combinations).
3. **Transitions**: 0.5s crossfades or dips-to-black.
4. **Subtitles**: Capped at **maximum 8 words appearing at a time** (can be fewer based on natural speech beats and pauses), positioned cleanly in the lower third.

chatLog.message:
Here is my script context:
Picture a friend's kitchen that looks spotless — clean counters, calm quiet in the air. But on the stove sits a pressure cooker (a sealed pot that cooks using trapped steam), heat on high, safety valve shut tight. From outside, the room looks peaceful. Underneath, dangerous pressure builds against the metal walls.

This is what happens inside someone who hides their feelings. Society celebrates such people — quiet, dependable, calm in every crisis — and others envy that strength.

But psychology and neuroscience (the study of the brain and nervous system) tell a different story. Hiding feelings isn't emptiness — it's an active, exhausting effort, like holding a door shut against a raging storm. This piece looks behind that calm exterior: why people build these walls, what it costs their bodies, and how they can safely open up.



Psychologist James Gross's Process Model of Emotion Regulation shows emotions unfolding like a play: a situation happens, a person notices it, judges its meaning, then feels a response.

There are two ways to manage this play. The first is cognitive reappraisal — changing how a situation is interpreted before it upsets someone, like rewriting the script before the actors walk on stage. If a boss doesn't reply to an email, a person might assume he's simply busy. This activates the prefrontal cortex (the brain's decision-making region), calming the amygdala and insula (areas processing fear and bodily sensation), so the body stays relaxed.

People who hide their feelings rarely do this. Instead they rely on expressive suppression — letting the actor walk on stage boiling with rage, but forcing a smile and stillness. This happens late, after the emotion has already formed. The prefrontal cortex works overtime locking down the face and voice, but the amygdala and insula stay highly active underneath. The person looks calm; the brain is screaming.

This mismatch strains the body. The autonomic nervous system (which controls heart rate and stress response) goes into overdrive, predicting chronic physical complaints over time. Suppression also blunts the brain's reward system, dulling the ability to feel joy alongside pain — a kind of emotional grayness.


Nobody decides one day to start hiding feelings — it's usually a survival strategy learned in childhood.

Imagine a child forced into an adult's business suit, carrying a briefcase, managing grown-up problems because the adults at home are unavailable or overwhelmed. Family psychology calls this parentification — taking on adult responsibilities too early.

Such a child learns a painful rule: feelings are a burden. Crying is ignored, silence is praised as maturity. Their nervous system adapts through a dismissing-avoidant attachment style (a pattern where closeness feels unsafe): depending on others leads to disappointment, vulnerability to rejection.

As adults, they keep wearing that heavy suit, hardened into hyper-independence. They appear successful — tireless problem-solvers who never ask for help — but this is really a trauma scar. Asking for help triggers deep, primitive shame; needing something feels like a catastrophic loss of control.

workflow.title: Check Inputs & AI Agent Thinking Initialization
workflow.instruction: Confirm script (text), images (anchor phrase filenames), and audio (voiceover) are all present. AI Agent enters step-by-step thinking & validation mode.

workflow.title: Connect to OpenAI Whisper STT for Word-Level Transcription
workflow.instruction: Run voiceover audio through OpenAI Whisper STT (Large-v3 engine) to extract word-level speech timestamps (exact start/end time of every spoken word).

workflow.title: Match Images to Script Anchors
workflow.instruction: Extract anchor phrases from image filenames (~first 5 words of sentence). Search script text sequentially for exact/near-exact matches.

workflow.title: Sequence Images
workflow.instruction: Order image clips according to the exact sequence their matched anchor phrases appear in the script text from start to finish.

workflow.title: Assign Timing to Each Image

workflow.title: Confirm Full Timed Sequence
workflow.instruction: Verify every image has a precise start time, end time, and continuous timeline position derived from script text and Whisper speech audio.

workflow.title: Apply 16:9 Longform Motion Varieties, Crossfades & Max 8-Word Subtitles

workflow.decisionRule: Maintain clean, cinematic 16:9 documentary pacing with max 8 words per caption card.

skills.editingRules:
# Silent Strategist Skill — Core Matching Workflow

This describes the foundation stage of the Silent Strategist Skill: turning a script, a set of images, and a voiceover audio file into a fully sequenced and timed video with OpenAI Whisper STT, AI thinking reasoning, motion varieties, and tailored subtitle formatting.

## Step 1: Check Inputs & AI Agent Thinking Process
Confirm that all three required inputs are received: script text, image files, and voiceover audio track. The AI Agent enters a structured thinking state (reasoning through input validation, acoustic waveform analysis, and sequence alignment before execution).

## Step 2: OpenAI Whisper STT Word-Level Transcription
Run the voiceover audio through OpenAI Whisper STT (Large-v3 / API) configured for forced alignment to return word-level timestamps (exact start and end time of every individual spoken word).

## Step 3: Match Images to Script Anchor Phrases
Each image's filename is a short anchor phrase (typically the first ~5 words of a sentence in the script). Search the script text to locate each image's anchor phrase sequentially. The remaining words in a sentence belong to that same image until the next anchor phrase begins.

## Step 4: Sequence the Images
Order images in the exact order their anchor phrases appear in the script from start to finish.

## Step 5: Assign Timing to Each Image using Whisper
Set each image's start time to the Whisper timestamp where its anchor phrase begins being spoken. Set end time to where the next anchor phrase starts.

## Step 6: Confirm Full Timed Sequence
Ensure zero gaps and continuous timeline coverage from start to finish.

## Step 7: Apply Rich Motion Varieties
Cycle clips through diverse motion varieties:
1. **Zoom In**: Scale 1.00 → 1.18
2. **Zoom Out**: Scale 1.20 → 1.00
3. **Move Left**: Pan X +35 → -35
4. **Move Right**: Pan X -35 → +35
5. **Move Up**: Tilt Y +35 → -35
6. **Move Down**: Tilt Y -35 → +35
7. **Zoom & Move Left**: Scale 1.00 → 1.22 + Pan X 0 → -40
8. **Zoom & Move Right**: Scale 1.00 → 1.22 + Pan X 0 → +40
9. **Zoom & Move Up**: Scale 1.00 → 1.22 + Tilt Y 0 → -40
10. **Zoom & Move Down**: Scale 1.00 → 1.22 + Tilt Y 0 → +40

## Longform 16:9 Finishing Stage:
1. **Aspect Ratio**: 16:9 Landscape (1920×1080).
2. **Motion Varieties**: Rotate across 10 motion patterns (Zoom In, Zoom Out, Move Left/Right/Up/Down, Zoom + Move combinations).
3. **Transitions**: 0.5s crossfades or dips-to-black.
4. **Subtitles**: Capped at **maximum 8 words appearing at a time** (can be fewer based on natural speech beats and pauses), positioned cleanly in the lower third.

skills.name: Viral Pacing & Hook Retention
skills.activity: Pacing, hook trimming, silence removal, and cut frequency
skills.description: Enforces rapid hook retention, tight jump-cut pacing, and micro-trimming of breath pauses for high watch-time.

workflow.title: Hook Optimization (First 3s)
workflow.instruction: Cut initial shot durations to 0.8s–1.4s maximum. Apply 1.15x punch zoom on first emphasized word.

workflow.title: Dialogue Silence Trimming
workflow.instruction: Trim dead air over 0.35s on A-Roll voice track.
workflow.decisionRule: Choose L-cut if speech continues into B-Roll, otherwise snap ripple cut without gaps.

chatLog.message:
Here is my script context:
Picture a friend's kitchen that looks spotless — clean counters, calm quiet in the air. But on the stove sits a pressure cooker (a sealed pot that cooks using trapped steam), heat on high, safety valve shut tight. From outside, the room looks peaceful. Underneath, dangerous pressure builds against the metal walls.

This is what happens inside someone who hides their feelings. Society celebrates such people — quiet, dependable, calm in every crisis — and others envy that strength.

But psychology and neuroscience (the study of the brain and nervous system) tell a different story. Hiding feelings isn't emptiness — it's an active, exhausting effort, like holding a door shut against a raging storm. This piece looks behind that calm exterior: why people build these walls, what it costs their bodies, and how they can safely open up.



Psychologist James Gross's Process Model of Emotion Regulation shows emotions unfolding like a play: a situation happens, a person notices it, judges its meaning, then feels a response.

There are two ways to manage this play. The first is cognitive reappraisal — changing how a situation is interpreted before it upsets someone, like rewriting the script before the actors walk on stage. If a boss doesn't reply to an email, a person might assume he's simply busy. This activates the prefrontal cortex (the brain's decision-making region), calming the amygdala and insula (areas processing fear and bodily sensation), so the body stays relaxed.

People who hide their feelings rarely do this. Instead they rely on expressive suppression — letting the actor walk on stage boiling with rage, but forcing a smile and stillness. This happens late, after the emotion has already formed. The prefrontal cortex works overtime locking down the face and voice, but the amygdala and insula stay highly active underneath. The person looks calm; the brain is screaming.

This mismatch strains the body. The autonomic nervous system (which controls heart rate and stress response) goes into overdrive, predicting chronic physical complaints over time. Suppression also blunts the brain's reward system, dulling the ability to feel joy alongside pain — a kind of emotional grayness.


Nobody decides one day to start hiding feelings — it's usually a survival strategy learned in childhood.

Imagine a child forced into an adult's business suit, carrying a briefcase, managing grown-up problems because the adults at home are unavailable or overwhelmed. Family psychology calls this parentification — taking on adult responsibilities too early.

Such a child learns a painful rule: feelings are a burden. Crying is ignored, silence is praised as maturity. Their nervous system adapts through a dismissing-avoidant attachment style (a pattern where closeness feels unsafe): depending on others leads to disappointment, vulnerability to rejection.

As adults, they keep wearing that heavy suit, hardened into hyper-independence. They appear successful — tireless problem-solvers who never ask for help — but this is really a trauma scar. Asking for help triggers deep, primitive shame; needing something feels like a catastrophic loss of control.

skills.editingRules:
# Silent Strategist Skill — Core Matching Workflow

This describes the foundation stage of the Silent Strategist Skill: turning a script, a set of images, and a voiceover audio file into a fully sequenced and timed video with OpenAI Whisper STT, AI thinking reasoning, motion varieties, and tailored subtitle formatting.

## Step 1: Check Inputs & AI Agent Thinking Process
Confirm that all three required inputs are received: script text, image files, and voiceover audio track. The AI Agent enters a structured thinking state (reasoning through input validation, acoustic waveform analysis, and sequence alignment before execution).

## Step 2: OpenAI Whisper STT Word-Level Transcription
Run the voiceover audio through OpenAI Whisper STT (Large-v3 / API) configured for forced alignment to return word-level timestamps (exact start and end time of every individual spoken word).

## Step 3: Match Images to Script Anchor Phrases
Each image's filename is a short anchor phrase (typically the first ~5 words of a sentence in the script). Search the script text to locate each image's anchor phrase sequentially. The remaining words in a sentence belong to that same image until the next anchor phrase begins.

## Step 4: Sequence the Images
Order images in the exact order their anchor phrases appear in the script from start to finish.

## Step 5: Assign Timing to Each Image using Whisper
Set each image's start time to the Whisper timestamp where its anchor phrase begins being spoken. Set end time to where the next anchor phrase starts.

## Step 6: Confirm Full Timed Sequence
Ensure zero gaps and continuous timeline coverage from start to finish.

## Step 7: Apply Rich Motion Varieties
Cycle clips through diverse motion varieties:
1. **Zoom In**: Scale 1.00 → 1.18
2. **Zoom Out**: Scale 1.20 → 1.00
3. **Move Left**: Pan X +35 → -35
4. **Move Right**: Pan X -35 → +35
5. **Move Up**: Tilt Y +35 → -35
6. **Move Down**: Tilt Y -35 → +35
7. **Zoom & Move Left**: Scale 1.00 → 1.22 + Pan X 0 → -40
8. **Zoom & Move Right**: Scale 1.00 → 1.22 + Pan X 0 → +40
9. **Zoom & Move Up**: Scale 1.00 → 1.22 + Tilt Y 0 → -40
10. **Zoom & Move Down**: Scale 1.00 → 1.22 + Tilt Y 0 → +40

## Longform 16:9 Finishing Stage:
1. **Aspect Ratio**: 16:9 Landscape (1920×1080).
2. **Motion Varieties**: Rotate across 10 motion patterns (Zoom In, Zoom Out, Move Left/Right/Up/Down, Zoom + Move combinations).
3. **Transitions**: 0.5s crossfades or dips-to-black.
4. **Subtitles**: Capped at **maximum 8 words appearing at a time** (can be fewer based on natural speech beats and pauses), positioned cleanly in the lower third.

chatLog.message:
Here is my script context:
Picture a friend's kitchen that looks spotless — clean counters, calm quiet in the air. But on the stove sits a pressure cooker (a sealed pot that cooks using trapped steam), heat on high, safety valve shut tight. From outside, the room looks peaceful. Underneath, dangerous pressure builds against the metal walls.

This is what happens inside someone who hides their feelings. Society celebrates such people — quiet, dependable, calm in every crisis — and others envy that strength.

But psychology and neuroscience (the study of the brain and nervous system) tell a different story. Hiding feelings isn't emptiness — it's an active, exhausting effort, like holding a door shut against a raging storm. This piece looks behind that calm exterior: why people build these walls, what it costs their bodies, and how they can safely open up.



Psychologist James Gross's Process Model of Emotion Regulation shows emotions unfolding like a play: a situation happens, a person notices it, judges its meaning, then feels a response.

There are two ways to manage this play. The first is cognitive reappraisal — changing how a situation is interpreted before it upsets someone, like rewriting the script before the actors walk on stage. If a boss doesn't reply to an email, a person might assume he's simply busy. This activates the prefrontal cortex (the brain's decision-making region), calming the amygdala and insula (areas processing fear and bodily sensation), so the body stays relaxed.

People who hide their feelings rarely do this. Instead they rely on expressive suppression — letting the actor walk on stage boiling with rage, but forcing a smile and stillness. This happens late, after the emotion has already formed. The prefrontal cortex works overtime locking down the face and voice, but the amygdala and insula stay highly active underneath. The person looks calm; the brain is screaming.

This mismatch strains the body. The autonomic nervous system (which controls heart rate and stress response) goes into overdrive, predicting chronic physical complaints over time. Suppression also blunts the brain's reward system, dulling the ability to feel joy alongside pain — a kind of emotional grayness.


Nobody decides one day to start hiding feelings — it's usually a survival strategy learned in childhood.

Imagine a child forced into an adult's business suit, carrying a briefcase, managing grown-up problems because the adults at home are unavailable or overwhelmed. Family psychology calls this parentification — taking on adult responsibilities too early.

Such a child learns a painful rule: feelings are a burden. Crying is ignored, silence is praised as maturity. Their nervous system adapts through a dismissing-avoidant attachment style (a pattern where closeness feels unsafe): depending on others leads to disappointment, vulnerability to rejection.

As adults, they keep wearing that heavy suit, hardened into hyper-independence. They appear successful — tireless problem-solvers who never ask for help — but this is really a trauma scar. Asking for help triggers deep, primitive shame; needing something feels like a catastrophic loss of control.

# Silent Strategist Skill — Core Matching Workflow

This describes the foundation stage of the Silent Strategist Skill: turning a script, a set of images, and a voiceover audio file into a fully sequenced and timed video with OpenAI Whisper STT, AI thinking reasoning, motion varieties, and tailored subtitle formatting.

## Step 1: Check Inputs & AI Agent Thinking Process
Confirm that all three required inputs are received: script text, image files, and voiceover audio track. The AI Agent enters a structured thinking state (reasoning through input validation, acoustic waveform analysis, and sequence alignment before execution).

## Step 2: OpenAI Whisper STT Word-Level Transcription
Run the voiceover audio through OpenAI Whisper STT (Large-v3 / API) configured for forced alignment to return word-level timestamps (exact start and end time of every individual spoken word).

## Step 3: Match Images to Script Anchor Phrases
Each image's filename is a short anchor phrase (typically the first ~5 words of a sentence in the script). Search the script text to locate each image's anchor phrase sequentially. The remaining words in a sentence belong to that same image until the next anchor phrase begins.

## Step 4: Sequence the Images
Order images in the exact order their anchor phrases appear in the script from start to finish.

## Step 5: Assign Timing to Each Image using Whisper
Set each image's start time to the Whisper timestamp where its anchor phrase begins being spoken. Set end time to where the next anchor phrase starts.

## Step 6: Confirm Full Timed Sequence
Ensure zero gaps and continuous timeline coverage from start to finish.

## Step 7: Apply Rich Motion Varieties
Cycle clips through diverse motion varieties:
1. **Zoom In**: Scale 1.00 → 1.18
2. **Zoom Out**: Scale 1.20 → 1.00
3. **Move Left**: Pan X +35 → -35
4. **Move Right**: Pan X -35 → +35
5. **Move Up**: Tilt Y +35 → -35
6. **Move Down**: Tilt Y -35 → +35
7. **Zoom & Move Left**: Scale 1.00 → 1.22 + Pan X 0 → -40
8. **Zoom & Move Right**: Scale 1.00 → 1.22 + Pan X 0 → +40
9. **Zoom & Move Up**: Scale 1.00 → 1.22 + Tilt Y 0 → -40
